schema.units: pixels in the 1080x1080 reference, origin top-left, y down; frame = 0-based index from sequential cv2.VideoCapture reads, t = frame/30
schema.glass.pose.rows: [frame, cx, cy, sx, sy, score]: map frame-119 glass coords p -> (cx + sx*(px-352.5), cy + sy*(py-617.5)); score = NCC of outline ink
schema.glass.art: frame-119 empty glass geometry/colours (see glass_art.json for per-frame boil spread)
schema.liquid.rows: [frame, yc, b, yMidLeft, yMidRight, residStd, bodyHex, bandHex, fitScore]: surface ellipse centre y (x centre 349), half-height b; back arc y = yc - b*sqrt(1-u^2), front arc y = yc + b*sqrt(1-u^2), u=(x-349)/a, a = 122.5-0.075*(yc-580); yMidLeft/Right = measured midline at x<299 / x>399 (tilt check); null = no liquid
schema.liquid.halfWidth: liquid body half-width at row y: a(y) = 122.5 - 0.075*(y-580), centre x 349; body bottom ≈ y 757 at x 352 (dark rounded bottom edge)
schema.ice.tracks: {ice1|ice2|ice3: [[frame, x, y, angle, scale, score]]} same convention as analysis-01 (0° = axis-aligned, grey highlight corner top-right), cube side 71*scale
schema.spoon.rows: [frame, ballX, ballY, angle, bowlX, bowlY, ballFrom]: ball = ball-top sphere centre; angle 0 = vertical, + = ball leans right of bowl; bowl = ball + L*(−sin a, cos a); ballFrom top = measured, bowl = derived from the bowl end
schema.peel.rows: [frame, cx, cy, areaPx, bbox, principalAxisDeg, x, y, angle, sx, sy, score]: x,y,angle,sx,sy map the frame-830 peel (art.contours, centroid art.centroid) -> scale (sx along screen x, sy along y, about centroid), rotate clockwise by angle, translate centroid to x,y
schema.bubbles: {frame: [[x, y, r, kind, hex]]}  kind gin-bubble-ring (grey outline circle) | campari-drop | vermouth-drop (filled)
schema.rays[].frames: [frame, x1, y1, x2, y2, widthPx, satMedian]; satMedian ramps up while the ray fades in
